lessons.title: Making polite requests

items.exampleMeaning: Could you please speak more slowly?
I would like to leave a message.

items.example: Dürfte ich bitte einen Moment Ihrer Zeit haben?
items.exampleMeaning: May I please have a moment of your time?
I need your help.

items.example: Wäre es möglich, dass Sie mir die Unterlagen schicken?
items.exampleMeaning: Would it be possible for you to send me the documents?
Would you please repeat?

lessons.tip: Use 'Könnten Sie bitte...' for polite requests. This is a common way to ask someone to do something politely in German.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: Could you please speak more slowly?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Ja, kein Problem! Ich möchte eine Nachricht hinterlassen.
dialogue.meaning: Yes, no problem! I would like to leave a message.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: Do you have the phone number?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: Yes, I need your help.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Könnte ich mit Herrn Müller sprechen?
dialogue.meaning: Could I speak with Mr. Müller?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: Would you please repeat?

scenario.partnerRole: You are a receptionist answering a call.
scenario.learnerRole: You are the caller trying to leave a message.
scenario.brief: Ask for the person you want to speak to and leave a message.
scenario.goal: You need to leave a clear message.

lessons.title: Spelling names

items.exampleMeaning: How do you spell your name?
That is my name: Schmidt.
Please say it slowly.
I write it down.
Could you please repeat that?

items.example: Es tut mir leid, ich verstehe nicht.
items.exampleMeaning: I'm sorry, I do not understand.

lessons.tip: When spelling names, use 'Wie buchstabiert man...?' to ask how to spell something. This is very helpful in conversations.

scenario.partnerRole: You are a person on the phone giving your name.
scenario.learnerRole: You are trying to understand the spelling of the name.
scenario.brief: Ask how to spell the name and clarify if needed.
scenario.goal: You need to correctly spell the name.

lessons.title: Leaving messages

items.meaning: I would like to leave a message.
items.example: Ich möchte eine Nachricht für Frau Müller hinterlassen.
items.exampleMeaning: I would like to leave a message for Mrs. Müller.
Please call me back.

items.meaning: I am waiting for your call.
items.exampleMeaning: I am waiting for your call.

items.example: Es ist wichtig, dass Sie anrufen.
items.exampleMeaning: It is important that you call.
When can I reach you?

items.text: Ich hoffe, Sie haben einen schönen Tag.
items.meaning: I hope you have a nice day.
items.example: Ich hoffe, Sie haben einen schönen Tag.
items.exampleMeaning: I hope you have a nice day.

lessons.tip: When leaving a message, use 'Ich möchte eine Nachricht hinterlassen.' This makes it clear that you want to leave information for someone.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Ich möchte eine Nachricht für Frau Müller hinterlassen.
dialogue.meaning: I would like to leave a message for Mrs. Müller.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: Please call me back.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: I am waiting for your call.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Es ist wichtig, dass Sie anrufen.
dialogue.meaning: It is important that you call.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: When can I reach you?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Ich hoffe, Sie haben einen schönen Tag.
dialogue.meaning: I hope you have a nice day.

scenario.partnerRole: You are leaving a message for someone.
scenario.learnerRole: You are the person receiving the message.
scenario.brief: Ask for details about the message and when to call back.
scenario.goal: You need to leave a complete message.

lessons.title: Taking messages

items.exampleMeaning: Who is speaking there on the phone?
I am taking the message.
I will pass it on.

items.meaning: Would you like to add something?
items.example: Möchten Sie etwas zur Nachricht hinzufügen?
items.exampleMeaning: Would you like to add something to the message?
I am noting that down for you.
Thank you for your message.

lessons.tip: Use 'Wer spricht dort?' to ask who is on the line. This is a polite way to identify the caller.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: Who is speaking there on the phone?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: It's me, Anna.

dialogue.meaning: I am taking the message.

dialogue.meaning: I would like to leave a message for Mr. Schmidt.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: I will pass it on.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: Thank you for your message.

scenario.partnerRole: You are taking a message for someone else.
scenario.learnerRole: You are the caller leaving a message.
scenario.brief: Ask for the caller's name and message details.
scenario.goal: You need to leave a clear and complete message.
